about_the_game:
Do You Remember? is a single-player exploration and puzzle story game with nostalgic and surreal yet grounded visuals, and a horror tone.

The Journey.

You find yourself walking and alone, without memory of the path you came from, no memory at all. Something feels strange about this world, its unwelcoming, and yet it calls to you.
You are driven at first to remember why you were walking this way, but to find answers you must wander further. A constant, looming shadow of dread follows you along your journey... Remnants your past and truths of the world and what lies further ahead are along the paths you choose.

Gameplay

As you journey through the world, you’ll need to feel your way forward, testing the ground, learning its rules, and deciding when to tread carefully or when to put yourself at risk for your willingness to face what waits ahead. Solve puzzles, complete quests, uncover the secrets along your journey towards.

Themes:

"Do You Remember?" is a journey. The story explores themes of nostalgia, death, and the minds world.
The gameplay includes exploring, minigames, puzzle solving, finding and collecting, and much more.

Remember this page for the demo, and the public playtest of the demo before that.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: AMD ryzen 3100 / intel 7600k
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1630/1050TI or AMD Radeon RX 570 4gb
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: any DX12 gpu with support for shader model 6 (SM6) 4gb or more vram should be able to run the game at 30+fps.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: AMD ryzen 5600 / intel 12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 8gb / Radeon RX 6600 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Additional Notes: 1080p or 1440p high settings with hardware ray tracing no upscaling or quality upscaling

short_description: You find yourself in a strange world, calm, but with no memory of anything before, not even who you were. You embark on a long journey trying to remember your past, discovering the secrets around you, and find answers. But the peril grows...
